# CollectionGenerator

[![NuGet](https://img.shields.io/nuget/v/CollectionGenerator.svg)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/CollectionGenerator)

Generates collections from members in C#.

## Example

Your code:

```cs
namespace ExampleNamespace;

public partial class ExampleClass {
    [AddTo("MyCollection")]
    public static readonly string TestString1 = "Hello";
    [AddTo("MyCollection")]
    public static readonly string TestString2 = "World";

    public static readonly ImmutableArray<string> MyCollection;
}
```

Generates:

```cs
// <auto-generated />

#nullable enable

namespace CollectionGenerator;

[System.AttributeUsage(System.AttributeTargets.Field | System.AttributeTargets.Property, AllowMultiple = true, Inherited = false)]
public sealed class AddToAttribute(params string[] ArrayNames) : System.Attribute {
    public string[] ArrayNames { get; } = ArrayNames;
}

```

```cs
// <auto-generated />

#nullable enable

namespace @ExampleNamespace;

partial class ExampleClass {
    static ExampleClass() {
        @MyCollection = [
            @TestString1,
            @TestString2,
        ];
    }
}

```

## Example - Existing Static Constructor

If your type already has a static constructor, a static method is generated instead.

Your code:

```cs
namespace ExampleNamespace;

public partial class ExampleClass {
    [AddTo("MyCollection")]
    public static readonly string TestString1 = "Hello";
    [AddTo("MyCollection")]
    public static readonly string TestString2 = "World";

    public static readonly ImmutableArray<string> MyCollection;

    static ExampleClass() {
        ExampleClass_AddTo(out MyCollection);
    }
}
```

Generates:

```cs
// <auto-generated />

#nullable enable

namespace @ExampleNamespace;

partial class @ExampleClass {
    private static void @ExampleClass_AddTo(out @System.Collections.Immutable.ImmutableArray<string> @MyCollection) {
        @MyCollection = [
            @TestString1,
            @TestString2,
        ];
    }
}

```
